correctness.rationale: Disjoint child subtrees give independent Bernoulli child truths, hence exact recursion b_{d+1}=P(Bin(n,b_d)>=ceil(nr)) for weak and >nr for strict, b0=1/2. For r≠1/2 the first tail tends to 0 or1 with a strict gap; Hoeffding propagates at each fixed depth. At central r, odd n has no tie and fair-binomial self-fixpoint b_d=1/2 exactly. Even n has first weak bias (1/2)*binom(n,n/2)/2^n ~ 1/sqrt(2pi n); triangular binomial CLT at the second layer gives Phi(sqrt(2/pi))=0.787531258..., a strict >1/2 limit, so Hoeffding forces all fixed subsequent depths to 1. Binomial reflection gives exact strict=1-weak for all n,d at r=1/2; minimal depth with parity nonconvergence is 2. Independent exact rational recursion for n=1..13, d=1..3 and numerical even n up to1280 verified symmetry/complement and approach to the correct Gaussian constant, without being used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete threshold and depth classification for a well-defined logical fragment, rather than arbitrary numerical boundary, isolates unique ratio 1/2 and exact earliest depth2 nonconvergence. The nontrivial Gaussian constant and depth3 saturation expose a meaningful tie-amplification mechanism relevant to nested majority logic and hierarchical voting, despite relying on classical probability ingredients.

final_claim: For independently fair leaf labels on complete n-ary directed trees and fixed modal depth d>=1, weak and strict iterated ratio-threshold modalities have deterministic limits 1 below r=1/2 and 0 above; at r=1/2 odd arities stay 1/2 while even arities yield 1/2 at d1, Phi(sqrt(2/pi)) at d2 and 1 at d>=3 for weak, with strict exact complementary probabilities.
limitations: Only complete disjoint-subtree frames, independent fair leaf bits, fixed depth and fixed ratio as n increases.
